purpose: Fill the known NVDA official TTM gap using comparative columns already present in the FY2027 H1 10-Q, without re-scraping a full filing set, without changing repositories, run packages, gates, or the Page, and without producing a price target.

issuer.name: NVIDIA Corporation
issuer.fiscal_year_convention: 52- or 53-week fiscal year ending on the last Sunday in January. FY2026 was a 52-week year. The FY2026 10-K states FY2027 will be a 53-week year with a 14-week fourth quarter.
issuer.share_basis: Common stock, $0.001 par value. The FY2026 10-K states that all share, equity award and per share amounts presented have been retrospectively adjusted for the June 2024 ten-for-one stock split.

reuse_of_existing_local_documents.reason: The FY2026 10-K and FY2027 H1 10-Q HTML/text were already in /workspace/akshare-supplement/data/official/source-documents. This pass extracted prior-year H1 comparatives from those files and fetched only public company IR/news pages for official period-end date corroboration. No SEC identity was sent and no login or rate-limit bypass was used.
reuse_of_existing_local_documents.gap_in_prior_json: Those files recorded FY2026 and current FY2027 H1 (six months ended 2026-07-26) flow items, but did not capture the same 10-Q's prior-year comparative column (six months ended 2025-07-27). That omission, not a missing filing, was what blocked official FY + current YTD - prior YTD.

reasons: 2026-07-26 is a Sunday fiscal period end; there is no Nasdaq official closing price on that calendar date.
The 10-Q and 10-K reviewed in this pass do not disclose a total market capitalisation as at 2026-07-26.
The 10-Q cover outstanding figure (24.1 billion) is as of 2026-08-21 and is rounded, so it is not a same-date precise share base for 2026-07-26.

A price on Friday 2026-07-24 multiplied by Sunday 2026-07-26 shares would not be a same-calendar-day official pair, and a self-calculated product must not be described as independently verified official market cap.

This calculation excludes 1.0 billion shares held by directors and executive officers of the registrant.
historical_official_non_affiliate_market.why_not_a_substitute: Different date (2025-07-25, a Friday), and a non-affiliate market value, not total market cap at 2026-07-26.
